title: plugin-auth: derive the SCIM connection-id cap from SCIM_SERVICE_PRINCIPAL_PREFIX
body:
domain:server#3 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cytQjG9X1CrCgytUM5

Follow-up of #30958 / #30960 (PRs #30991 and #30989, both merged).

`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/scim-connection-admin.ts` computes `MAX_SCIM_CONNECTION_ID = MAX_TEXT - 'svc:scim:'.length` (246) with the prefix spelled literally. #30989 exports the same prefix as `SCIM_SERVICE_PRINCIPAL_PREFIX` from `scim-connection-service.ts`. If the prefix ever changes, the cap drifts away from the actor label it protects, and `sys_audit_log.actor` (255) could overflow.

Fix: import `SCIM_SERVICE_PRINCIPAL_PREFIX` and use its `.length`. The existing unit pin (246 accepted, 247 refused, `9 + 246 === 255`) keeps holding. This is a one-line change, `patch` on `@objectstack/plugin-auth`.

Optional in the same stroke: the #30991 changeset names the two routes but not the two new public `AuthManager` methods (`isScimWired`, `mintScimConnectionCredential`). Adding one "Exported" line would complete the record.
